title: A Short History of Nearly Everything

contents: Part I, Lost in the Cosmos: the Big Bang, the solar system, and the discovery of the universe's scale
Part II, The Size of the Earth: weighing, measuring, and dating the planet
Part III, A New Age Dawns: Einstein, relativity, quantum theory, and the atom
Part IV, Dangerous Planet: meteor impacts, earthquakes, and the Yellowstone supervolcano
Part V, Life Itself: the cell, Darwin, DNA, and the improbable persistence of life
Part VI, The Road to Us: human evolution and the precarious rise of our species

audiences: Readers who found school science dull and suspect it shouldn't have been
Young readers and adults wanting one grand tour of scientific knowledge
